Name: Forage Crops and Goods Remix
Author: Shreedle
Description:
[size=4][b]Mod has been updated for SDV 1.6+.[/b][/size]

In the time that I updated this mod to be compatible with SDV 1.6+, I added several new options.[b][u]

Changes new to V2.0.0[/u][/b]
-Most processed Jellies/Pickles are edible as of 1.6+, so the mod was tweaked to make it so that base Jelly/Pickles can be edible.
-Coconut, Rhubarb, Wheat, and Tea Leaves can be edible.
-Red Mushroom and Truffle can be driable in the Dehydrator.
-Daffodil, Dandelion, Sweet Pea, Crocus, Eggplant, and Summer Squash can be Fruit.
-Daffodil, Sweet Pea, Crocus, and Truffle can be Vegetable.
-Sweet Pea, Crocus, and Truffle can be Forage.
-Unmilled Rice can be No Category.
-Made minor edits to some edited descriptions.[b][u]

This mod allows for the following recategorizations:[/u][/b]
-[b]Inedible to [color=#00ffff]Edible[/color][/b]: Jellies, Pickles, Honey, Ancient Fruit, Coconut, Rhubarb, Wheat, Tea Leaves, Sweet Gem Berry, Golden Pumpkin
-[color=#ffd966][b]Not Driable[/b][/color] to[color=#1e84cc] [b]Driable[/b][/color]: Red Mushroom, Truffle
-[b][color=#ff00ff]Flower[/color][/b] to [b][b][color=#cc0000]Fruit[/color][/b][/b]: Sweet Pea, Crocus
-[b][color=#ff00ff]Flower[/color][/b] to [b][color=#6aa84f]Vegetable[/color][/b]: Sweet Pea, Crocus
-[b][color=#ff00ff]Flower[/color][/b] to [b][color=#B45F06]Forage[/color][/b]: Sweet Pea, Crocus
-[b][color=#B45F06]Forage[/color] to [color=#ff00ff]Flower[/color][/b]: Daffodil, Dandelion, Holly
-[b][color=#B45F06]Forage[/color] to [color=#cc0000]Fruit[/color][/b]: Hazelnut, Daffodil, Dandelion, Holly
-[b][color=#B45F06]Forage[/color] to [color=#6aa84f]Vegetable[/color][/b]: Wild Horseradish, Leek, Spring Onion, Winter Root, Snow Yam, Cave Carrot, Ginger, Daffodil, Dandelion, Holly, Red Mushroom, Purple Mushroom, Common Mushroom, Chanterelle, Morel, Magma Cap
-[b][color=#cc0000]Fruit[/color] to [color=#6aa84f]Vegetable[/color][/b]: Hot Pepper, Rhubarb
-[b][color=#6aa84f]Vegetable[/color] to [color=#cc0000]Fruit[/color][/b]: Eggplant, Tomato, Pumpkin, Summer Squash
-[b][color=#6aa84f]Vegetable[/color][/b] [b]to [color=#9900ff]No Category[/color][/b]: Hops, Tea Leaves, Wheat, Unmilled Rice
-[b][color=#9900ff]No Category[/color] to [color=#cc0000]Fruit[/color][/b]: Sweet Gem Berry, Golden Pumpkin
-[b][color=#9900ff]No Category[/color] to [color=#6aa84f]Vegetable[/color][/b]: Truffle, Seaweed, Green Algae, White Algae, Golden Pumpkin
-[color=#9900ff][b]No Category[/b][/color] [b]to[/b] [b][color=#B45F06]Forage[/color][/b]: Truffle

Suggestions for more are welcome.

By using the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url], you can toggle each individual item included in this mod to keep it vanilla or change it. If you wish to keep the vanilla category for an item or use different, conflicting mods, set it to '[b]Off[/b]'.

Doing this affects the Artisan Goods that you can make. Unique Producer outputs such as Hops to Pale Ale are unaffected.

[u]For example:[/u]
-Switching [b]Hops[/b] from [b][color=#6aa84f]Vegetable[/color][/b] to [b][color=#9900ff]No Category[/color][/b] still allows for [b]Pale Ale[/b] to be made, but can no longer be made into [b]Pickled Hops[/b].
-Switching [b]Sweet Gem Berry[/b] from [b][color=#9900ff]No Category[/color][/b] to [b][color=#980000][b][color=#cc0000]Fruit[/color][/b][/color][/b] allows for [b]Sweet Gem Berry Jelly[/b], [b]Sweet Gem Berry Wine[/b], and [b]Dried Sweet Gem Berry[/b] to be made.
-Switching [b]Purple Mushroom[/b] from [b][color=#B45F06]Forage[/color][/b] to [b][color=#6aa84f]Vegetable[/color][/b] will still allow you to make [b]Dried Purple Mushrooms[/b], but you can now make [b]Purple Mushroom Juice[/b].
-Switching [b]Red Mushroom[/b] from [b][color=#B45F06]Forage[/color][/b] to [b][color=#6aa84f]Vegetable[/color][/b] [b]&[/b] [color=#1e84cc][b]Driable[/b][/color] allows for [b]Red Mushroom Juice[/b], [b]Pickled Red Mushrooms[/b], and [b]Dried Red Mushrooms[/b] to be made.

Artisan Goods that already exist in your game will remain if you change settings.

Beehouses WILL NOT make Honey from anything recategorized as Flowers with only this mod. To get these Honey, you would need to either find a mod that allows Beehouses to make the Honey, or use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/93]CJB Item Spawner[/url]. Preserves Jars, Kegs, Dehydrators, and Mills should make everything as expected.

There is a known bug where if Sweet Gem Berry and Golden Pumpkin are switched to either Fruit/Vegetable but NOT Edible, the Artisan Goods produced from them may heal 100% instead of a fixed number. Have not figured out how to edit a specific flavor of Jelly/Pickle/WIne/Juice/Dried items just yet. =/

[b][u]To install manually:[/u][/b]
1) Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url].
2) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
3) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].
4) Download this mod and unzip into your Mods folder.
5) (Optional) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2080]Even Better Artisan Good Icons[/url].
6) (Optional) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15761]Even Better Artisan Good Icons - Wrong Artisan Good Icons[/url]
Done!

(Interface mod pictured in images is [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14027]Sakura Interface Redux[/url].)
